note: Orchestrator art direction (2026-10-08, owner instruction: 'Ensure unique art planned for every illustration'). Chapter subjects replace the legacy ChatGPT-era subjects; 'direction' gives a concrete, unique visual subject where the flavour text is abstract or another entry would otherwise look the same. Flavour text is still quoted verbatim in every prompt. The six approved-pending anchors carry no direction so their specs stay unchanged.

ART-CH01-002.subject: The Dying Lands seen from a broken mountain pass: a cracked imperial road winding down toward the skeletal towers of a dead city on the horizon, forest to one side and frozen peaks to the other; a small party with a banner pauses on the road in the foreground
ART-CH01-002.composition: Wide vista; party small at lower left; road leads the eye to the distant dead city

ART-CH02-002.subject: Two rival adventuring parties sighting each other across a fog-filled valley of ruined walls at first light, each crouched behind cover with weapons ready, a monster's silhouette moving in the mist between them
ART-CH02-002.composition: Wide shot; one party at lower left, the other small at far right; fog band across the middle

ART-CH03-002.subject: Dawn of a new round: a weary party gathering behind a ruined wall as a lone chapel bell tower stands over a drowned field
ART-CH03-002.composition: Wide shot, low horizon, bell tower silhouette at right

ART-CH04-002.subject: A party crossing the broken spans of a collapsed aqueduct: one climbs a rope, one leaps a gap, one braces to catch, the gorge falling away below
ART-CH04-002.composition: Strong diagonal of the broken aqueduct; figures mid-motion; deep drop beneath

ART-CH05-002.subject: A desperate melee on a narrow stone bridge: adventurers locked shield-to-shield against a press of undead soldiers, one hero falling back wounded, the river far below
ART-CH05-002.composition: Bridge seen from a low three-quarter angle; the clash at centre; ranks of undead receding into fog

ART-CH06-002.subject: A crowded hiring hall inside a Bastion: adventurers of many ancestries (dwarf, elf, ratkin, orc, halfling, human) bargaining over a contract nailed to a post beneath captured banners, a clerk with a ledger and coin scales
ART-CH06-002.composition: Interior wide shot; contract post at the focal centre; figures grouped around it

ART-CH07-002.subject: A Deepwarden forge cut into the rock: a smith quenching a glowing blade in a trough as steam rises, finished mail, helms and axes on racks, an apprentice working the bellows
ART-CH07-002.composition: Interior; smith at the focal centre; racks framing both sides

ART-CH08-002.subject: A lone caster standing in the burned shell of an academy library at night, pages and embers swirling upward around them as a ring of force flares from an outstretched hand
ART-CH08-002.composition: Tall broken shelves framing the figure; swirl of pages around the focal point

ART-CH09-002.subject: The aftermath of a hunt at the forest's edge: a party standing over a slain beast too large to drag home, crows gathering on the carcass, eyes glinting in the treeline behind
ART-CH09-002.composition: Carcass across the foreground; party in the middle ground; treeline dark behind

ART-CH10-002.subject: A party at a ruined crossroads reading a weathered, carved waystone; six roads lead away, toward forest, ruined city, mountain caves, ice, desert and fen on the horizon
ART-CH10-002.composition: Waystone at centre; roads fanning out; six distant landscapes along the horizon

ART-CH11-002.subject: A battered party returning at dusk by fen-lantern light, carrying their wounded on a litter toward their stronghold's palisade gate, watchers on the wall above
ART-CH11-002.composition: Gate at right; procession along a muddy track from the left; lanterns as focal points

direction.ART-WOR-1-2-THE-GRIM-WORLD: Two warlords' banners planted on either side of a burnt farmstead; a tax collector's cart and armed men in the yard while a peasant family flees down the lane.
direction.ART-WOR-1-3-1-THE-FALL: The colossal broken head of an imperial statue lying half-buried in a ploughed field, a farmer and ox small beside it; nobody knows what toppled it.
direction.ART-WOR-1-3-2-THE-SIX-CLIMATES-OF-RUIN: A sweeping panorama from the spine of the broken mountains showing all six climates under one sky: the great forest to the west, the dead imperial city to the east, ice to the north, dunes to the south, drowned fen to the south-east, and dark cavern mouths in the mountains below the viewer; a lone surveyor with a staff in the foreground.
direction.ART-WOR-1-3-3-THE-SIX-BASTIONS: A great Bastion gate grinding shut at dusk, guards straining at the windlass inside while desperate figures outside reach for the closing gap.
direction.ART-WOR-1-3-4-MAGIC-IN-THE-DYING-LANDS: A still life on a cracked altar: five damaged implements, one per tradition - a scorched spellbook, a chipped holy symbol, a bloodied ritual knife, a withered antler-and-holly charm, and a cracked crystal - each broken in its own way.
direction.ART-WOR-1-3-5-MONSTROUS-THREATS: An abandoned village street: claw-torn doors, an empty well, and a crude monster banner planted where the market cross once stood.
direction.ART-WOR-1-3-6-ADVENTURERS-AND-THE-ROAD: A small party walking out of a Bastion's postern gate along a muddy road, past a gibbet and a weathered warning post, toward a dark forest edge.
direction.ART-WOR-1-3-7-LEGENDS-AND-ECHOES: A barrow field at dusk where faint ghostly warriors of an ancient battle re-enact their last charge through the living grass, drawn only in sparse fine lines.
direction.ART-ITE-7-6-TREASURE-TABLES: A still life of grim treasure: a rotted purse spilling tarnished coins beside a skeletal hand, a mud-caked crown, a cracked reliquary and a salt-crusted signet ring.
direction.ART-ITE-7-8-MELEE-WEAPONS: A still life of salvaged arms laid on sacking: a long-bladed messer, a notched swordbreaker, a throwing cross, a bladed scourge, a weighted cord and a hook-and-chain.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-1-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20: A young apprentice at a scarred practice post conjuring a small flame in one hand while a shimmer of force bends the air before the other.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-2-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20: A wizard hurriedly copying a spell from a scorched tome by candlelight while the library behind them burns.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-3-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20: A wizard sifting ash and cipher-scraps among robed corpses on the floor of a ruined tower, a sealed book clutched to their chest.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-1-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20: A priest raising a lantern whose light falls on a wounded soldier, the wound visibly knitting closed.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-2-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20: A weary cleric kneeling at a cracked roadside shrine beside a ledger of offerings, candles guttering.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-3-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20: A priest with arms raised on a hilltop, demanding, as a vast ambiguous shape takes form in the storm clouds above.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-1-SORCERIES-D20: A close view of a sorcerer's cut palm, drops of blood rising and twisting into a small crackling spark.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-2-SORCERIES-D20: A gaunt sorcerer with scar-laddered forearms channelling a crackling storm between their hands.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-3-SORCERIES-D20: A sorcerer half-consumed by their own working, a vortex of force tearing up the ground, villagers praying on their knees at a safe distance.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-1-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20: A druid kneeling with one palm pressed to an exposed root, a hare and a crow watching, rain beginning to fall.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-2-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20: A druid speaking aloud as the surrounding trees bend toward them and roots heave up out of the earth.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-3-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20: A druid half-merged with an ancient oak, bark creeping over their skin and branches rising like antlers from their head.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-1-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20: A psion seated with closed eyes, pebbles hovering in a slow ring around them and a candle flame standing perfectly still.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-2-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20: A psion alone in a dark corridor, hiding a trembling hand, fine cracks of strain around their eyes.
direction.ART-TRA-TIER-3-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20: A psion on a battlefield where stone steps and a wall rise from nothing at their gaze, enemies stumbling as the ground obeys the psion's thought.
direction.ART-CAM-11-1-CAMPAIGN-OVERVIEW: A stronghold under construction from salvage: workers hauling shrine stones and broken bridge spans up a ramp, scaffolding around a half-built keep.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-VAULT: A low iron-bound vault room; a clerk dozing on a stool beside chests and coin scales while a second clerk counts by candle.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-BARRACKS: Rows of straw bunks under heavy beams carved with names; damp wool and boots hung to dry; one empty bunk with a helmet left on it.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-ARMOURY: Racks of salvaged arms: blades from drowned shrines, a shield hammered flat by dragon-fire, ownerless helms on pegs, an oil-cloth bench.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-APOTHECARY: A cramped workroom of glass alembics over a brazier, bone saws and knives on a cloth, shelves of labelled-less jars and hanging bitter herbs.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-OUTER-WALLS: The stronghold's ditch, spiked palisade and stone wall at night, warding nails driven into the timbers, a lone sentry with a torch on the walkway.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-ARCANUM: A thin, too-tall tower against a night sky, upper windows burning, brass instruments on its roof turned toward a storm.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-STRONGHOLD-CHAPEL: A small cold chapel crowded with votive offerings, chipped saint statues and low candles, a single mourner kneeling.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-WAR-ROOM: A heavy table under captured banners, stained maps pinned with knives, a contract and quill, a hearth burning behind.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-EXPEDITION-HALL: A packed-earth training yard inside split-post walls: a scarred veteran correcting a recruit's guard, blunted weapons on a rack, mud underfoot.
direction.ART-CAM-THE-UNDERCROFT: A vaulted cellar warren lit by one lantern, a hidden door ajar, a cloaked figure slipping into an older passage below.
direction.ART-ANC-HUMAN: A human traveller of a Bastion in layered road clothes with a pack, walking staff and short sword; ordinary, weathered and determined.
direction.ART-ANC-HALFLING: A halfling traveller in a hooded cloak with a sling, a well-kept pack and a cooking pot, alert and capable.
direction.ART-ANC-ELF: An elf traveller, tall and lean, in a long weathered cloak with a longbow and quiver, calm and watchful.
direction.ART-ANC-GNOME: A gnome traveller with tinkering tools and lenses on a bandolier, a small crossbow and a heavy satchel.
direction.ART-ANC-GOBLIN: A goblin adventurer in a Bastion's employ: patched but well-kept leathers, a short blade and lantern, wary intelligence in the face; clearly a hired hero, not a raider.
direction.ART-ANC-ORC: An orc adventurer in a Bastion's employ: heavy travel-worn armour, a greataxe slung, scarred but composed; a sworn hireling, not a raider.
direction.ART-ANC-RATKIN: A ratkin adventurer in a hooded cloak and Bastion tabard, satchel of scavenged tools, bright watchful eyes; a hired hero, not a scavenger.
direction.ART-ANC-DEEP-ELF: A deep elf adventurer who has come to the surface: pale skin, a hood pulled against daylight, fine dark armour and a curved blade; an outcast hireling, not a warrior of the deep courts.
direction.ART-ANC-DEMONBORN: A demonborn traveller with small horns, a tail and ember-like eyes, dressed in a plain pilgrim's cloak.
direction.ART-ANC-DRAKEBLOOD: A drakeblood traveller with scaled skin along jaw and hands and a ridge of small horns, in a heavy cloak with a spear.
direction.ART-MON-GREEN-DRAGON: A typical adult green dragon of its kind, alone, coiled on a mossy rock; no lair, no tribute.
direction.ART-MON-WHITE-DRAGON: A typical adult white dragon, alone on a jagged ice outcrop with wings half-raised; no spire, no city.
direction.ART-MON-BLUE-DRAGON: A typical adult blue dragon bursting up out of a dune, sand cascading from its horns.
direction.ART-MON-BLACK-DRAGON: A typical adult black dragon rising from open black water, acid dripping from its jaws; no ruin or architecture.
direction.ART-MON-MAELTHORN-THE-VERDANT: Maelthorn coiled in a forest clearing among Greythorn's autumn tithe offerings, moss and lichen furring its scales, poison fog spilling from its jaws.
direction.ART-MON-SIRRACH-THE-BLACK: Sirrach erupting out of solid stone in an unmapped gallery, the rock rippling like water around its black body.
direction.ART-MON-VISATH-THE-WHITE: Visath perched atop the highest frozen spire of the Pale City, wings spread, victims locked mid-scream in the ice below.
direction.ART-MON-VOSSEGAR-OF-THE-FLOODED-CATHEDRA: Vossegar coiled among submerged altars and broken pillars inside a drowned cathedral, black water rising around the nave.
direction.ART-MON-KHORRUN-THE-DRACOLICH: Khorrun's skeletal dragon body draped in tattered scale, coiled atop a hoard in a tomb gallery, ledgers stacked to the ceiling.
direction.ART-MON-THE-ANCIENT-VOID-DRAGON: The Ancient Void Dragon drawn mostly as negative space: a wyrm-shaped absence edged by fine lines, stars dimming around it.
direction.ART-MON-AVATAR-OF-THE-OLD-GROWTH: A colossal walking tree-giant towering over the forest canopy, roots dragging behind it, its crown a tangle of antlered branches.
direction.ART-MON-THE-ANTLERED-WARDEN-OF-THE-TITHE: A towering (Large) gaunt figure of bone-antler and living wood standing at Greythorn's west gate in winter snow, dragging a debtor by the collar.
direction.ART-MON-THE-BROODMOTHER-PRIME: The Broodmother squatting in a vast webbed cavern, cottage-sized, egg-sacs trailing, cocooned victims hanging in the webs.
direction.ART-MON-THE-HOLLOW-CROWN-OF-THE-ASHLANDS: A black iron circlet floating above an empty regent's robe on a ruined throne, ranks of dead legionaries kneeling below.
direction.ART-MON-THE-LAST-COLOSSUS: A riveted black-iron war-construct three times a man's height marching along a ruined imperial road, a small figure at its feet for scale.
direction.ART-MON-CAPTAIN-VEYR-OF-THE-FORSAKEN: Captain Veyr in spectral plate with paired blades raised, rallying a line of dead soldiers behind them.
direction.ART-MON-THE-FROST-BAILIFF-MAGISTRATE: The Frost Bailiff drifting down a frozen avenue in judicial robes, a figure freezing solid where they stand before it.
direction.ART-MON-THE-SUN-CROWNED-PRINCE: The Sun-Crowned Prince enthroned in a sealed tomb-court, a withered corpse in funeral linen beneath a bright crown of beaten gold.
direction.ART-MON-THE-VOICE-BENEATH-THE-BELLS: A small child-shaped figure at the edge of guttering torchlight in a flooded chapel, singing, the bells hanging silent above.
direction.ART-MON-MIRE-TITAN: A typical Mire Titan alone, waist-deep in fen water, reeds and mud sliding from its body; no geodes or hunters.
direction.ART-MON-FROST-WYVERN: A frost wyvern on the wing, two-legged and lean, distinctly smaller and rangier than a dragon.
direction.ART-MON-DEEP-ELF-WARRIOR: A deep elf warrior of the deep courts in full dark ceremonial armour with a crescent glaive, in the Undermarches gloom.
direction.ART-MON-DEEP-ELF-PRIEST: A deep elf priest in layered dark vestments raising a shadow-wreathed sigil staff.
direction.ART-MON-ORC: An orc raider of the Greenmark with crude trophies and a notched cleaver, mid-snarl, nothing like a sworn hireling.
direction.ART-MON-GOBLIN: A Greenmark goblin raider with a notched blade and river-stone sling, part of a mob; hunched and malicious.
direction.ART-MON-UNDEAD-WARRIOR: A half-rotted corpse, not a bare skeleton, in rusted imperial legion kit with a short sword and a rectangular shield, ash underfoot.
direction.ART-MON-SKELETON-WARRIOR: A bare sun-bleached skeleton in corroded bronze scale and a crested bronze helm, holding a curved bronze blade, sand underfoot.
direction.ART-MON-FROZEN-SKELETON: A frost-rimed skeleton with icicles hanging from its ribs and a sword frozen to its hand, snow drifted around its feet.
direction.ART-MON-UNDEAD-SENTINEL: A towering gaunt dead soldier planted in a broken gateway, rusted tower-shield grounded and reach-halberd raised.
direction.ART-MON-WHITE-COURT-GUARD: A frost-armoured noble corpse in ornate courtly armour and a frozen fur mantle, reach-halberd held at a ceremonial slant.
direction.ART-MON-WHITE-COURT-SENTINEL: A corpse-knight crouched behind an enormous greatshield, ornate visored helm, no polearm.
direction.ART-MON-WHITE-COURT-EXECUTIONER: A towering hooded headsman striding forward with a frost-rimed executioner's axe over one shoulder.
